<p>
This is an end-to-end workflow that walks through analyzing CosMx® whole transcriptome
single-slide dataset -- from loading flat files to quality processing to performing 
pathway analysis -- using open-source tools in a blend of R and Python. 
Here you will find best practices, interactive visualizations to show what effects
certain processing parameters have on the data, and applications of cutting-edge
tools that have been described in our blog, like HieraType.
</p>
